title: Network privacy copy omits the Grist network path

evidence.quote: This is the only time DocGit uses the network — everything else stays on your Mac.
Checks GitHub for a new version on launch — the only time DocGit uses the network.

reasoning: The app tells users that update checks are the only network use, but the same renderer exposes Grist connection fields for an arbitrary server and API key. That makes the privacy statement false once remote documents are supported, which can mislead users about data boundaries.
reproduction: Open the update note or Settings and read the network claim, then open Connect Grist and enter a non-local server URL.
recommendation: Qualify the update copy, e.g. automatic updates are the only background network use unless the user connects a Grist document, and add a concise network/data-boundary note in the Grist dialog.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests assert privacy copy against available network-enabled features.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a renderer copy test or snapshot around SettingsMenu/App update text and ConnectGristDialog ensuring the network claim includes the Grist exception.
minimumFixScope: apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/App.tsx and apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/components/SettingsMenu.tsx copy, optionally apps/desktop/src/renderer/src/views/Library.tsx Grist dialog hint.
